2609.08977.title: Omni Interaction Agent Technical Report
2609.08977.paper_summary: In this work, we present Gander, an end-to-end model that unifies omni perception, realtime interaction, and agentic capabilities within a single framework. In contrast to turn-based conventional paradigms, Gander continuously receives streaming inputs across multiple modalities, including video, speech, and text, enabling natural full-duplex interaction in both everyday conversations and complex workflow-oriented agent scenarios. Users can interrupt the model at any time, while the model can also proactively provide intermediate feedback or ask follow up questions. To natively support these capabilities, Gander adopts two key architectural designs: 1) It employs a Cerebellum-Brain collaborative framework, in which the Cerebellum is responsible for realtime interaction and omni conversational capabilities, while the Brain handles complex reasoning and higher-level agentic tasks. The two components interact continuously through tool calling and the agent orchestration runtime. 2) The Cerebellum is built upon a streaming Thinker-Talker architecture, user inputs and model outputs are further flattened into an ordered token stream at the chunk level, providing a unified representation for low latency, continuous interaction. We conduct comprehensive evaluations of Gander across four dimensions: conversational ability, omni understanding, interactive capability, and agentic intelligence. Internal human evaluations demonstrate that Gander maintains the natural and expressive spoken dialogue capabilities of SOTA open source models while achieving competitive performance in omni interaction. Gander also demonstrates robustness in challenging real-world scenarios, including background noise interference, multi-party interactions, and backchannel communication. We release Gander together with its models, code, and data to facilitate further research and development in the community.
2609.08977.paper_summary_zh: 在這項工作中，我們介紹了 Gander，一個將全方位感知、即時互動和代理能力統一於單一框架的端到端模型。與基於回合的傳統範式相比，Gander 持續接收來自多種模態的串流輸入，包括視頻、語音和文本，使得在日常對話和複雜的工作流程導向代理場景中實現自然的全雙工互動。用戶可以隨時打斷模型，而模型也可以主動提供中間反饋或提出後續問題。為了原生支持這些能力，Gander 採用了兩個關鍵的架構設計：1）它採用了一個小腦-大腦協作框架，其中小腦負責即時互動和全方位對話能力，而大腦處理複雜推理和高階代理任務。這兩個組件通過工具調用和代理協調運行時持續互動。2）小腦建立在一個串流的思考者-講話者架構上，用戶輸入和模型輸出進一步被扁平化為按塊級別排序的標記流，提供一個統一的表示，以實現低延遲的連續互動。我們在四個維度上對 Gander 進行了全面評估：對話能力、全方位理解、互動能力和代理智慧。內部人類評估顯示，Gander 在保持最先進開源模型自然且富有表現力的口語對話能力的同時，在全方位互動中也達到了具有競爭力的性能。Gander 在挑戰性的現實場景中也顯示出穩健性，包括背景噪音干擾、多方互動和回饋通信。我們釋放了 Gander 及其模型、代碼和數據，以促進社區進一步的研究和發展。
